title: Instruction side conditions
statement: For every bit string $x$, every state $s$ of the fixed multiplication program, every assignment of natural numbers to its thirteen registers, and either choice of recorded answer, the resulting configuration satisfies the program's instruction side conditions: register comparisons use distinct registers, and any list of registers supplied to an oracle call has no repetitions.
hypotheses_covered: Assignment of natural numbers to thirteen registers
